text: New addition: Recommended cash offer (scheme) of up to 88p per share, including a contingent consideration unit of 24p per share in the form of a loan note. Taboola.com had received irrevocable undertakings corresponding to 75.3% of Dianomi's shares. Completion expected before the end of 2026.
The Harworth Board Harworth remains unanimous and unequivocal in its rejection of the revised (mandatory) offer

Peel Holdings acquires, through market purchases, shares representing 0.04% of Harworth's shares. As a result, Peel Holdings's shareholding increases from 29.96% to 30.00% and the revised offer converts into a mandatory offer
